outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意
物質熱力學特性，改變能量形式之基本原理，熱力學第一及第二定律，可逆性與可用性，動力循環，冷凍循環，混合氣，化學反應。
Thermodynamic Properties of Substance, Energy Forms, The First Law of Thermodynamics, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Irreversibility & Availability, Power Cycle, Refrigeration Systems, Mixtures, Chemical Reactions.
schedule:
第1週: Thermodynamics and energy, dimension and units, closed and opened system, state and balance, process and cycle, types of the energy.
第2-3週: Pure material, phases of pure materials, phase varied process of pure material, property chart, ideal gas, specific heat, internal energy.
第4-5週: Heat transfer, energy transfer of the work, mechanical work, non- mechanical work, mass conservation law.
第6-7週: The first law of thermodynamics, the energy balance of closed system, the energy balance of opened system, some engineering devices of steady flow system.
第8週: The basic of second law, heat reservoir, heat engine
第9週：期中考
第10週: The energy transformation efficiency, refrigerator and heat pump, reversible and irreversible.
第11-12週: Entropy, entropy change of pure material, isotropic process, Mollier chart,Basic consideration of the power cycle.
第13-15週: Carnot cycle, Otto and Diesel cycle, Stirling and Ericsson cycle, Brayton cycle,Refrigeration, heat pump, Steam compressed refrigeration cycle, refrigerant, Heat pump system, dry air and atmosphere, specific humidity and relative humidity. .
第16週: 期末考
第17週: 自主學習
第18週：自主學習
